description: EXTRACT returns an integer on MySQL, unlike PostgreSQL's numeric -- the analyzer must not apply one dialect's answer to every engine
name: date_extract_mysql_returns_int
query_sql:
-- @name ExtractDatePartsMysql
-- @returns :many
SELECT id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM occurred_at) AS yr FROM events
schema_sql: CREATE TABLE events (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, occurred_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL);
